notes.title: Answers to various questions about the game
notes.notes: I'm very glad that you adventurers have participated in my game development. This game was developed by myself. It's only two days since it was launched. I've received three feedback messages. I'm very happy. This week, I hope to get more opinions and suggestions from adventurers. According to the information collected, I will summarize and update the game. Thank you for your company. I will try my best to develop this game and bring you more opportunities More happy game experience.
